node.title: Re: Match variables : Beginner in perl
node.author: choroba
node.doctext:
\w matches a "word character", but for a rather non-intuitive meaning of "word": it means it's an underscore, a digit, or a letter. Nothing more. If you want to include a single quote, you can use e.g. a character class [\w']

Note that it includes quoting single quote, too. E.g. "I don't like 'big mouths'", said he.

I'm not sure you'd like to treat 'big as a "word".
